whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Pour Tous,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.0★ reviews with over 1,600 happy customers in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/pourtous

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team Pour Tous, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Pour Tous) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

*(If checked)*: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu showcase, and highlighting your strong 1,600+ reviews in Patliputra Colony. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

*(If not checked)*: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
